{{Short description|American archer}}
'''Benita Jean Edds''' (born 12 June 1958 in [[Sullivan, Indiana|Sullivan]]) is an American former [[archer]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BENITA JEAN EDDS |url=https://www.olympic.org/benita-jean-edds |website=www.olympic.org |accessdate=18 February 2020}}</ref>

==Life==

Edds graduated from [[Indiana State University]] in 1981 gaining a major in [[life science]] and [[medical technology]]. She later became a [[chemist]] for [[Eli Lilly and Company|Eli Lilly]] and [[dog breeder]]. She was inducted into the Indiana State University Athletics Hall of Fame in 1998.<ref>{{cite web |title=BENITA J. EDDS |url=https://gosycamores.com/hof.aspx?hof=70 |website=gosycamores.com |accessdate=18 February 2020}}</ref>

==Archery==

Edds competed in the [[1984 Summer Olympic Games]]. She came 34th with 2366 points scored in the [[Archery at the 1984 Summer Olympics – Women's individual|women's individual event]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Benita Edds |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ed/benita-edds-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418045310/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ed/benita-edds-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |website=www.sports-reference.com |accessdate=18 February 2020}}</ref>
